requirements.desc: Hook discovery must reject installed plugin hook modules that import core internal project paths before dynamic import. Relative imports that stay within the plugin package remain allowed.
requirements.note: R1: hook discovery rejects core-internal imports before importing hooks

requirements.desc: Snapshot hook execution must hard-fail when a snapshot entry references a disabled plugin, missing installed plugin, unresolved hook module, invalid register(api) export, invalid hook class, or mismatched className/command/hook/priority metadata.
requirements.note: R2: snapshot hooks hard-fail for disabled, removed, unresolved, and mismatched entries

requirements.desc: Hook run business failures must remain non-blocking command warnings and issue-log candidates when the snapshot entry and hook metadata are valid.
requirements.note: R3: hook run business failures remain non-blocking warnings after valid snapshot checks

requirements.desc: Flow hook artifact helpers must read JSON artifacts and write JSON/text artifacts under specs/<spec>/plugin-artifacts/<pluginId>/ for hooks executed with an active flow spec path. Missing files passed to readJson must preserve the existing fallback return behavior.
requirements.note: R4: flow hook artifacts read and write under the active spec directory

requirements.desc: Spec-local tests under specs/287-fix-plugin-foundation-gaps/tests/ must cover R1 through R4 with requirement headers, and shared plugin foundation tests may be updated only to align with the corrected production contract.
requirements.note: R5: spec-local test coverage declares every testable requirement
